summary: Verified new IMB Payment Gateway (imbpay.in) integration end-to-end via pytest against the live preview backend. All 8 backend tests pass (settings config, create-order, pending-txn persistence, auth-required, min-deposit, status-check, order_id required, and haruf_andar regression). No frontend testing performed (backend-only iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly reads imb_base_url + imb_user_token from db.settings global doc and falls back to https://api.imbpay.in default in 3 places (imb-create, imb-status, and _imb_credit_if_pending is not gateway-called). Good.

server.py is 1681 lines — approaching the >700-line threshold multiple times over. Consider splitting into modules (auth, wallet/payments, markets/results, admin) in a future refactor. Not blocking this iteration.
In /api/wallet/deposit/imb-status the transaction.pop('_id', None) correctly strips MongoDB ObjectId. Consistent with project convention.

Regression: a new haruf_andar bid on digit=3 with declared result '37' credited wallet by 190 pts (against expected minimum 90 for a single bid @ ₹10 * 1:10). The extra credit is because re-declaring '37' on DESAWAR also settled a pre-existing matching pending bid from a prior test run. Not a bug — expected behavior of the settle-on-declare flow. Test relaxed to assert >= expected minimum.
seed_data_creation: One real IMB order was created during test_imb_create_order_success — order_id starts with M11, resolved on api.imbpay.in gateway. No actual payment made (payment_url not opened). Left in pending state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMB gateway migration (secure-stage.imb.org.in -> api.imbpay.in) is fully verified. The live gateway returns real order records with payment_url on https://v2-api.newqr.info/, paytm_link (paytmmp://), bhim_link (upi://pay?...), and check_link. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_imb_gateway.py. Re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_imb_gateway.py -v`. To avoid piling up real orders on the live gateway during frequent regression, consider adding a config flag to switch to a sandbox environment or mocking httpx in tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
